column1: This file is used to list counters that :
1 - shall not be set as ERRMIS when they appear to be missing compare to previous run history
2 - that must not be set as ERR when they are out of the default expected range
To add a new counter, you shall add a new line with the following fields (semicolon separated) :
- with "is known as misssing" for the first case, followed by the counter id and its definition (optional)
- with "shall not be checked" for the second case, followed by the test case type it shall apply (part of the TC name), the counter id and its definition (optional)
